patterns.note: Alternating two-column content blocks (image left/text right, then text left/image right) are used consistently for feature sections, providing visual balance and variety.
Key headlines and impactful statements utilize an extremely large, expressive serif font, creating strong visual anchors and an editorial feel, especially in full-width sections.
Strategic use of multi-color gradient backgrounds for the hero and footer sections, transitioning between soft, complementary hues to define page boundaries and add visual depth.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid white background with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls down the page, becoming sticky at the top.
Full-width sections with distinct background colors (e.g., dark teal, gradient) and oversized typography are used to punctuate the content flow and highlight key messages.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky navigation, implement a header element that is initially fixed at the top with a transparent background. Use JavaScript to detect scroll position, and once a certain threshold is passed, apply a class that changes the background to solid white and adds a subtle box shadow, ensuring it remains fixed.
Create full-bleed hero and footer sections using CSS linear gradients that smoothly transition between 2-3 specified colors, providing a soft, modern backdrop for content.

Establish a strong typographic hierarchy by using a custom serif web font for primary headings, set at significantly larger sizes (e.g., 3-6x body text size) to command attention, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif font.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, expressive serif headings (~3-6x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and card-like containers, maintaining a generally clean aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major content sections, with balanced padding within content blocks to ensure readability and a sense of openness.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with its bold and editorial use of typography, particularly the extremely large, custom serif font for key headlines that creates a strong, almost artistic presence. The strategic application of multi-color gradient backgrounds for hero and footer sections, combined with distinct full-width color blocks, gives it a sophisticated yet approachable feel that avoids generic marketing templates.
